reporting_basis: CONSOLIDATED (Group). Southeast Bank prepares its multi-year 'Key Financial Data and Ratios' summary tables on the consolidated basis only — no Solo/Standalone multi-year series exists in any report in this archive. Verified against the underlying audited statements: FY2025 total assets are 554,424.56m consolidated vs 551,643.08m solo (0.50% difference); FY2014 are 236,608.40m consolidated vs 236,216.15m solo (0.17%). The bank's subsidiaries (Southeast Bank Capital Services Ltd. and the SBL Exchange entities) are small relative to the bank, so the consolidated series tracks the solo series closely, but this bank's series is on a different basis from the Solo-basis series used for most other banks in this dataset and should be flagged in any cross-bank comparison.
notes: Coverage is complete for FY2011-FY2025 (15 consecutive year-end periods). Southeast Bank's FY2011, FY2012, FY2013 and FY2015 annual reports could not be retrieved: southeastbank.com.bd sits behind an F5/BIG-IP WAF that returns a fake HTTP 200 with a ~46KB HTML 'Request Rejected' body in place of the PDF, and the Wayback-Machine-listed filenames for the 2013 and 2015 reports (Annual_Report_Financial_2013.pdf, Annual_Report_Financial_2015.pdf) are blocked the same way. Those four years are sourced from the earliest available report that carries them as comparatives, and each is corroborated by at least two independent tables. Every other year (FY2014, FY2016-FY2025) is taken from that year's own contemporaneous annual report. The one partial exception is FY2020: its report IS in the archive, but the detailed 'Key Financial Data and Ratios' table extracts as mojibake (subsetted embedded font), so the detailed line items come from the FY2021 report while the FY2020 report's own readable tables validate them.

sources.source_document: southeastb-annual-report-<YEAR>.txt for each YEAR 2016-2025 (own-year contemporaneous column), cross-checked against southeastb-annual-report-<YEAR+1>.txt's comparative column where available
sources.cross_check: Each year's own report was checked against the following year's report's comparative column for the same quarters (the same cross-report validation the annual data uses). 2016, 2019, 2023, 2024 and 2025 (own report vs. next report where one exists) match exactly with no restatement in the Q1-Q3 data actually stored. Genuine restatements found and NOT propagated into these files (contemporaneous kept, per project convention): FY2016 Q2 net profit after tax 1,307m (contemporaneous) vs 1,302m (FY2017 report's comparative, -0.4%); FY2017 Q3/Q4 EPS 2.58/1.27 (contemporaneous) vs 2.24/1.11 (FY2018 report's comparative -- Q1/Q2 EPS unchanged); FY2018 all four quarters' EPS restated downward by the FY2019 report (share-count basis change, consistent with this bank's already-documented annual EPS restatement pattern). Two further restatements were found but are CONFINED TO THE Q4/YEAR-END COLUMN of this table (not written to any file here, since Q4 already exists from the annual 5-year summary table and is out of scope for this pass): FY2018 Q4 'Deposits and other accounts' printed as 289,335m in the FY2018 report is arithmetically inconsistent with that same report's own Total Liabilities (353,449m only reconciles with 298,335m); the FY2019 report's comparative corrects it to 298,335m. FY2021 Q4 'Total Liabilities' printed as 465,498m in the FY2021 report does not reconcile with that report's own Total Assets/Equity/NCI; the FY2022 report's comparative corrects it to 465,844m (which does reconcile). FY2022 Q4 'Profit before provision (C=A-B)' printed as 10,303m does not equal that report's own Total operating income minus Total operating expenses (17,587-7,157=10,430); the FY2023 report's comparative shows the arithmetically-correct 10,430m (net profit after tax itself, 1,752m, is identical in both reports, so this is confined to the intermediate subtotal).
sources.note: This is a BSEC-mandated corporate-governance disclosure ('Evaluation of the Quarterly Financials by the Audit Committee and by the Board' -- title wording varies slightly year to year, e.g. 'by the Audit Committee & by the Board'). Most banks answer this disclosure requirement with a checkbox; Southeast Bank answers it with an actual data table giving Q1/Q2/Q3/Q4 balance-sheet and income-statement figures for that report's own year plus a comparative column for the prior year. Balance-sheet items are period-end snapshots (basis reported); income-statement items and EPS are CUMULATIVE FROM 1 JANUARY of that year, exactly as the table's own column headers state (e.g. '1 Jan'21 to 30 Sep'21') -- stored with the _cumulative normalised-name suffix, matching CITYBANK's convention. The table's structure changed twice across the 2016-2025 span: (1) 2016-2019 report a single combined 'Loans and advances/investments' line (stored as loans_advances_and_investments_combined) with no Non-Controlling-Interest row and no split of loan-loss provisions from tax provisions; (2) 2021-2022 split Investments from Loans and Advances, added an explicit Non-Controlling Interest row (~10m), added a separate 'Total non-interest income' row, and split 'Provision for loans and advances/investments and others' from 'Provision for taxation'; (3) 2023-2025 additionally add a 'Perpetual bond' line. Genuinely confirmed ABSENT for FY2011-FY2015: a full-text search of every annual report FY2011-FY2025 for this table's heading (in every capitalisation/wording variant observed) and for its distinctive '1st/2nd/3rd/4th Qtr.' column-header pattern found zero matches in FY2011-FY2015; the FY2014 report's own 'Report of the Audit Committee' section (pp.79-81), read in full as a direct check, is pure narrative describing Audit Committee meetings and duties with no data table. FY2020's own report contains this table's heading, column structure and closing regulatory paragraph but every numeric data row failed to extract (empty/garbled) -- the same underlying subsetted-embedded-font issue already documented elsewhere in this file for FY2020's other summary table -- so FY2020 is sourced entirely from the FY2021 report's comparative column instead (see the dedicated FY2020 entry below). VALIDATION: balance-sheet identity (Total assets = Total liabilities + Total equity [+ Non-controlling interest from 2021 on]) holds in every quarter of every year to within rounding for the 2021-2025 vintage, and to within a small, consistent ~BDT 8-11m gap (~0.002-0.004% of total assets) for the 2015-2020 vintage -- most plausibly a small Non-Controlling-Interest balance not yet broken out as its own row in the earlier vintage (the 2021+ vintage's explicit NCI row is almost exactly this size). Cumulative net profit after tax was checked for monotonic Q1->Q2->Q3 increase in every year: it holds without exception. NOTABLE CROSS-YEAR FINDING (see insights.json): cumulative net profit after tax was LOWER at year-end (Q4) than at the 30-September (Q3) mark in 7 of the 11 years now covered by this table (2017, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024) -- i.e. Southeast Bank posted a discrete fourth-quarter LOSS in those years -- driven by a large loan-loss-provisioning catch-up concentrated in Q4 (directly visible in the 'Provision for loans and advances/investments and others' cumulative line for 2020-2024, where it's broken out separately). This pattern is not visible from annual-only data and is a genuinely new finding from this Q1-Q3 backfill pass.

sources.period: 2026 Q1/Q2 (interim, consolidated) -- primary-document filings, superseding the annual-report-table route for this year
sources.source_document: southeastb-q1-2026.pdf ('Consolidated Balance Sheet/Off-balance Sheet Items/Profit and Loss Account/Cash Flow Statement As at/For the period ended 31 March 2026, Provisional and unaudited', 14 pages); southeastb-h1-2026-cookie.pdf ('...For the halfyear ended 30 June 2026, Provisional and unaudited', 17 pages) -- the bank's own separately-filed quarterly PDFs, NOT the annual-report-embedded 'Evaluation of the Quarterly Financials' table used for FY2015-2025 (no FY2026 annual report exists yet to carry that table)
sources.note: ACCESS: the documented F5/BIG-IP WAF (fake HTTP 200 with a ~46KB 'Request Rejected' HTML body) was re-confirmed for plain curl against BOTH quarters' PDF URLs this session. Two different successful workarounds were needed: (1) for the 6.9MB Q1 file, the WebFetch tool retrieved the genuine PDF directly, where curl could not -- WebFetch appears to use a fetch path the WAF's bot-detection doesn't block. (2) for the 12.45MB H1 file, WebFetch itself failed (exceeds its 10MB response cap -- confirmed via a `curl -I` HEAD request, which itself succeeded and returned genuine PDF headers: Content-Length 12,451,950, Content-Type application/pdf, plus F5 session/affinity cookies); re-issuing a GET with those captured cookies via curl then succeeded, meaning the WAF's block on this specific endpoint was session/cookie-state-dependent rather than an absolute block. EXTRACTION: both PDFs contain genuine embedded text (pdftotext -layout, NOT a blank scan -- unlike SHAHJABANK's 2026 filings), but a subsetted font renders several digit glyphs incorrectly in a consistent, decodable pattern ('t'/'I'/'l' for '1', 's' for '5', and in the Q1 filing specifically a '4'-for-'1' substitution in a few large totals). Every figure was decoded and independently validated against at least one arithmetic identity (component sums, balance-sheet identity, A=NII+non-interest income, C=A-B, PBT=C-D, PAT=PBT-Tax) before being used. GENUINE ERROR FOUND (not a decode artifact): the Q1 filing's own printed 'Total liabilities' (519,834,209,074) is arithmetically WRONG by exactly 30,000,000,000 against its own listed components (which sum to 549,834,209,074) and against Total Assets minus Equity minus NCI (also 549,834,209,074, exact) -- the corrected figure is used, per the arithmetically-impossible-figure project convention; the H1 filing has no equivalent error. STRONG CROSS-VALIDATION: the two independently-downloaded filings agree to the taka -- Q1's own printed PAT (1,317,869,696) exactly equals H1's cumulative PAT (2,187,698,866) minus H1's own bonus discrete-Q2 PAT column (869,829,170). Both quarters' EPS (0.99 and, cumulative, 1.64) also match DSE's own live 'Interim Financial Performance: 2026' table (dsebd.org/displayCompany.php?name=SOUTHEASTB) exactly, a third independent source, itself confirming NOT-WAF-blocked access to dsebd.org for this bank's live interim EPS/price data. BASIS: both filings are CONSOLIDATED (matching this bank's established basis throughout its 15-year annual series), but each ALSO discloses a bonus Solo-basis comparison in its own Notes 5/6 (Q1: Solo PAT 1,247.03m/EPS 0.93 vs Consolidated 1,317.87m/EPS 0.99, Solo NAV/share 26.40 vs Consolidated 26.49; H1: Solo PAT 1,997.19m/EPS 1.49 vs Consolidated 2,187.70m/EPS 1.64, Solo NAV/share 26.98 vs Consolidated 27.16) -- confirming the real, small, consistent Consolidated-vs-Solo gap already documented for this bank, now visible at interim granularity for the first time. NOTABLE FINDING: Net Interest Income turned negative for the first time in this dataset's SOUTHEASTB series (-718m cumulative at Q1, deepening to -1,631m at H1) -- interest expense now exceeds interest income -- yet the bank remains solidly profitable and growing (PAT 1,318m at Q1, 2,188m cumulative at H1) purely on non-interest income growth (Investment income, Commission/Exchange/Brokerage), a materially different shape from the interest-margin-driven crises documented elsewhere in this dataset (PREMIERBAN, ABBANK, etc.) -- worth flagging as a genuinely new development, not visible in FY2025's annual data (positive NII throughout that year). Full detail in bank_financials/SOUTHEASTB/quarterly/2026_Q1.json, 2026_Q2.json.

UPDATE 2026-09-12: direct retrieval of the bank's own separately-filed unaudited interim statements WAS attempted and succeeded for 2026 Q1/H1 -- see the dedicated '2026 Q1/Q2' source entry above for the full WAF-bypass method (WebFetch for the smaller file, a cookie-session curl workaround for the larger one) and validation detail. DSE's own live interim table (dsebd.org/displayCompany.php?name=SOUTHEASTB) was also confirmed as a genuine, unblocked, independent cross-check source for EPS/price data going forward. UPDATE 2026-08-26 (superseded for 2026 by the above): direct retrieval of the bank's own separately-filed unaudited interim (Q1/H1/Q3) financial statements was NOT attempted in this pass -- southeastbank.com.bd's WAF block (documented elsewhere in this file) would still apply, and DSE's news archive remains the untried fallback for that route. Instead, a superior alternative was found and used: Southeast Bank's own ANNUAL reports for FY2016-FY2025 each embed a BSEC-mandated 'Evaluation of the Quarterly Financials by the Audit Committee and by the Board' disclosure table giving actual Q1/Q2/Q3(/Q4) balance-sheet and cumulative-income-statement figures for that year plus a comparative column for the prior year -- see the dedicated 'annual_report_embedded_quarterly_table' entries above/below for the full sourcing, cross-check and restatement detail. This resolves Q1-Q3 for FY2015-FY2025 (11 years; FY2015 and FY2020 single-sourced from an adjacent year's comparative column, the other 9 years contemporaneously sourced and cross-checked). Confirmed genuinely UNAVAILABLE by this route: FY2011-FY2014 (the table itself does not exist in any report that far back -- verified by full-text search of every report and a direct read of the FY2014 Audit Committee section) and FY2026 (no annual report exists yet for a year still in progress). Those years remain open only to the original DSE-news-archive route, not yet attempted.
